atoms.text: This level includes mentions of uncomfortable situations both at school and at home. If this level upsets you, you should speak with a trusted adult about it.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in one of Leoni’s personal boundaries.

atoms.sound: I don’t like to hug people who aren’t in my family

instruction.text: Read what happened next and decide what Leoni should do.

feedback.end: Now that Roberto is aware of Leoni’s personal boundary, he will know for the future.

atoms.a: Roberto thought that Leoni looked upset, so he decided to give her a surprise hug.

b.sound: hit Roberto because he crossed her personal boundary
stop the hug and explain her personal boundary to Roberto

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in one of Mo’s personal boundaries.

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+1.5st'>I don’t like playing rough games at lunchtime</prosody>

instruction.text: Read what happened next and decide what Mo should do.

feedback.end: Alex respected Mo by asking him nicely if he wanted to join in. Mo doesn’t have to play unless he wants to.

atoms.a: Alex asked Mo if he wanted to play wrestling during lunch.

b.sound: ignore Alex because he doesn’t want to play
politely say “no thank you” and find other friends to play with

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in one of Walt’s personal boundaries.

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+0.5st'>I don’t like talking about embarrassing moments</prosody>

instruction.text: Read what happened next and decide what Walt should do.

feedback.end: It’s never nice to be made fun of. If Walt’s friends keep ignoring his personal boundary, it is a good idea to ask a teacher for help.

atoms.a: Walt fell over in class, and his friends keep making jokes about it.

b.sound: ask his friends to stop talking about it, and talk to the teacher for help if they won’t stop
start hitting his friends because they are being mean

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in one of Priya’s personal boundaries.

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+5st'>I only tell my parents about my marks at school</prosody>

instruction.text: Read what happened next and decide what Priya should do.

feedback.end: If people don’t listen or understand when you tell them your personal boundaries, it is a good idea to ask a trusted adult for help.

atoms.a: Priya’s aunt keeps pressuring her to tell her what mark she got on her maths test.

b.sound: tell her aunt even though it would cross her personal boundary
explain her boundary to her aunt, and ask her parents for help if she keeps asking
